name: Marshmallow Test
summary: A trick-taking patience game where winning tricks makes you exit early to score points equal to opponents' tricks; first to 20 wins.
rules_text: Players are dealt 12 cards from a 60-card 5-suit deck. First round has no trump; in later rounds the dealer chooses trump after seeing their hand. Leader plays any card to set lead suit; others must follow suit if able. In trump rounds, if a player cannot follow and plays trump, all later players may play trump even if they could follow. Highest lead suit wins if no trump, else highest trump wins. Winner stacks the trick and leads next. When a player reaches the required number of collected tricks for the player count, they immediately go out, discard remaining hand, and score 1 per trick opponents have currently collected. Round ends when one player remains; that player scores nothing and deals next. Special 5-player rule if tricks run out. Play rounds until someone reaches 20 points.
rating_reason: Trick-taking with hidden hands, perfect for engine
